memories.content: The HR department is responsible for reviewing applications for the ward-clerk vacancy. They have received eleven applications by the closing deadline. They have internal criteria for selecting candidates to invite for interviews, but no decisions have been made yet.

The posting for the ward-clerk vacancy at Calloway Regional Hospital closed at 23:59 on 2026-09-30. Eleven applications were received. The HR department will review applications and may invite some applicants for interviews within two weeks of the closing date.
